SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写编号区域〕
No. S. D. D. 253271
Date August 18th, 1931
Subject (in full) Japanese marines re-seize goods held in Chapei by Anti-Japanese pickets.
Made by D.I. Schmidt Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕

Sir,
At 6 p.m. August 18, J.P.C. 148 reported at this Station that at 5.30 p.m. a party of Japanese marines, 40 to 50 strong, armed with rifles and led by officers, marched along Darroch Road to Peng Pang Road. Half the party then proceeded into Chapei and seized a quantity of goods, which were being held by pickets of anti-Japanese movement. No resistance was offered by the pickets or the Chapei Police, who witnessed the incident. The marines afterwards returned to their barracks on North Szechuen Road with the seized goods on a lorry.

Inquiries made by the undersigned and J.D.C. 42 Sugihara elicited the following information:- At 5 p.m. two wheelbarrows loaded with six cases of cotton yarn, value $800.00 were proceeding along the Paoshan Road, Chapei, when they were seized by anti-Japanese pickets. The owner of these goods a Mr. Takeuchi (Japanese), the proprietor of a cotton belt factory on Paoshan Road, had purchased same this afternoon from a Japanese firm in the Settlement, and the goods were on the way to his factory.

Mr. Takeuchi on being informed of what had occurred, reported the matter immediately to the Japanese Marine Headquarters, with the result as above stated. The property seized was subsequently returned to Mr. Takeuchi, the owner.

H. J. Schmidt
D. I.
Senior Detective i/c.

D. "C" Division.
(Copy forwarded to
Officer i/c, Special
Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写编号区域〕
编号 S. D. D. 253271
日期 1931年8月18日
事由（全称）日本海军陆战队重新夺回被闸北反日纠察队扣留的货物。
呈报人 侦探长 Schmidt 转呈人 〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕

先生：

8月18日下午6时，日籍警员第148号在本分局报告称，下午5时30分，一支由军官率领、配备步枪、人数约40至50人的日本海军陆战队分队，沿达罗克路（Darroch Road）行进至彭彭路（Peng Pang Road）。随后该队半数人员进入闸北，扣押了一批正由反日运动纠察队扣留的货物。目睹此事的纠察队及闸北警察未作任何抵抗。此后，海军陆战队用卡车将所扣货物运回其位于北四川路的兵营。

经卑职与日籍侦探副长第42号杉原（Sugihara）查询，获悉以下情况：下午5时，两辆装载六箱棉纱（价值800.00美元）的手推车正沿闸北宝山路行进时，被反日纠察队扣押。这批货物的所有者为竹内先生（Mr. Takeuchi，日本人），系宝山路一家棉带厂的主人，他于当日下午从租界内的一家日本商号购得此货，当时货物正运往其工厂。

竹内先生得知事发情况后，立即向日本海军陆战队司令部报告，遂产生上述结果。被扣财物随后已归还给所有者竹内先生。

H. J. Schmidt
侦探长
高级侦探主管

“C”分区。
（副本已转呈
特别分部
主管警官）。
